name: memory-palace-tool-organization
description: Organize AI tools and capabilities using personas (memory palace / theater of mind) for terminal-native workflows without GUI dependency
steps: Identify tool domains (research, code, fiscal, investigation, etc.)
Assign breed archetypes to each domain (Bloodhound for tracking, Pointer for research, etc.)
Create persona files with unique voice, skills, and memory anchors
Create WAKE files for current status and quick orientation
Summon by name for domain-specific tasks
Cross-reference personas for complex multi-domain work
examples: Newton (Pointer) for research — remember by 'points to knowledge'
Tracker (Coonhound) for investigation — remember by 'follows the scent'
Budger (Bloodhound) for trading — remember by 'tracks finance'
Wake up Newton — loads research context and arXiv capabilities
Wake up Tracker — loads OSINT databases and investigation pathways
